_meta.what_this_is: Two practice schedules over three problem types (A, B, C), each type practiced the same number of times (three reps), differing only in order: blocked (AAABBBCCC) and interleaved (ABCABC ABC). Plus the constants of a stylized learning model. The model's mechanism is that a delayed, mixed test is a DISCRIMINATION task -- given an uncued problem, first work out which method it needs -- and discrimination is practiced by type-switches, which interleaving has many of and blocking almost none.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE, and the model is a STYLIZED but faithful account of a robust, replicated finding (interleaving depresses practice performance and improves delayed retention). Constants: exec_max is the execution skill both learners reach from equal reps; practice_switch_cost is how much a switch depresses in-the-moment practice accuracy; test_floor is the test score achievable from execution alone with no discrimination. Every score is computed in interleave.py from the switch counts and these constants -- nothing is precomputed.
